fields.name: Required mapping
fields.definition: The `required` flag on a mapping attribute or shard key mapping. When the mapped database value is null, the Mapper treats the record as absent rather than as a record with a null property: a single-model read returns null, and a list read omits that row. Because nested model properties are flattened into their parent, a required column inside a nested model nulls the whole parent model, not just the nested property. When the Mapper drops a model this way, it logs the culprit column at Debug level.
